title: Evolving Local Rules for Agent Societies: A Preliminary Study

contributions.purpose: 提出 Evolutionary-Boids 框架:局部规则+进化选择驱动工具构建 agent 社会
contributions.mechanism: Boids 三规则(分离/对齐/凝聚)作 prompt 级条件信号,observe-reflect-build 循环,按 TCI 周期性淘汰/复制/变异
contributions.evaluation: gpt-4.1-nano;3 域(文本/数据科学/仿真);boids-only/evo-only/combined vs 全局基线对照
contributions.domain: 多 agent 系统 / 涌现协作 / 工具生成
contributions.source_quote: a preliminary framework that couples Boids-style local coordination with explicit evaluation and selection in a survival-driven, tool-building ecology

contributions.purpose: 实证 Boids 提升吞吐但抑制深度组合(breadth-depth trade-off)
contributions.mechanism: 对比每域工具数、pass rate、TCI 及 compositional complexity
contributions.evaluation: 工具数 13-18 vs 基线 9-14;compositional complexity 近零(Boids 0.01-0.04 vs 基线 0.03-0.21);pass rate 相当(mid-high 80%)
contributions.source_quote: evolutionary-Boids societies increase throughput and balance contributions among agents while maintaining reliability, though current prompting tends to suppress deep tool composition

contributions.purpose: 提出 Tool Complexity Index(TCI)静态度量工具复杂度
contributions.mechanism: TCI=Ccode[0,3]+Ciface[0,2]+Ccomp[0,5],纯 AST 静态分析,含 parsing quality gate(×0.6)
contributions.evaluation: 各域 avg TCI 稳定在 2.0-2.5 带,per-artifact 难度相近
contributions.source_quote: aTool Complexity Index that quantifies code, interface, and compositional sophistication

self_declared_provenance.quote: We adopt this micro-to-macro lens but recast alignment/cohesion/separation as institutional primitives subject to evolutionary pressure in survival-driven ecologies

notes: 无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+intro+conclusion 归纳。核心负结果/trade-off:breadth-depth——Boids 下 compositional complexity 近零(0.01-0.04 vs 基线 0.03-0.21),agent 极少复用已有工具。数据红旗:(1)破坏双盲——PDF 内直接署真名与邮箱(Xisen Wang / Qi Zhang, University of Oxford, xisen.agi@gmail.com),匿名会议提交却未匿名。(2)标题与批次清单不一致:PDF 标题'Evolving Local Rules for Agent Societies: A Preliminary Study',批次清单为'A Preliminary Exploration of Evolving Agent Societies through Simple Local Rules'(此处 title 用 PDF 原标题)。(3)abstract/conclusion 称'30–50% more valid artifacts',但 Table 1 实际增幅 14%(sim 14→16)至 80%(DS 10→18),范围与陈述不符。(4)checklist 自相矛盾:Q7 统计显著性[Yes]称'replicated runs across randomized initializations/topologies',但 Limitations 明言'fixed ring topology'、'few seeds'、'no pruning occurred'、'randomized multi-topology replications are left to future work'——即进化选择实际未真正执行,Q7 过度声称。(5)参考文献列表含'[14?]'未解析占位。AI 披露:hypothesis/experiments[C]、analysis/writing[D]。gpt-4.1-nano via Azure,提供 github repo。
